name: Keyrock Prime USDC
oneLiner: krUSDC is Keyrock's USDC lending vault on Arc; shares redeem at NAV when liquidity is available and bear strategy losses.
collateral: USDC lender positions in a single Morpho market secured by cirBTC on Arc
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue lending interest and bear losses against USDC. Redemption uses idle USDC and the configured liquidity adapter, subject to market liquidity. Force-deallocation currently charges 0.5%; in-kind exit retains lending-position exposure. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero, not measured exit capacity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Keyrock Prime USDC is an ERC-4626 pro-rata claim on USDC-denominated Morpho lending positions, bearing credit losses and liquidity constraints rather than a fixed fiat redemption obligation. At Arc block 26080279 (0xd45fba23210a5662823d06f1e292ca0e0798748413f29663b523b30568b955cf; 2026-10-15T10:44:09Z), totalSupply=75022024133358070384877635 raw 18-decimal shares and totalAssets=75080951234671 raw 6-decimal USDC. One adapter holds one cirBTC/USDC market; its realAssets and expectedSupplyAssets equal totalAssets, idle USDC is zero, and pending performance/management fee shares are zero. convertToAssets(1e18)=1000785 raw USDC. protocol-position intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent.
